workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Monday 09:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David are busy
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both Elena and David are busy
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy entire time; Elena busy 15:30-16:00
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy

However, here are the times when BOTH Elena and David are free:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check if Priya and Marcus are free during any of these Elena/David overlap times? It appears there may be no common availability for all four partners.
